scope: Seven new comparison columns; native product capabilities, not SDK adapter presence.

definitions.partial: Indirect, conditional, limited or separate endpoint; see cell evidence
definitions.none: Not exposed by the scoped documented contract, with specific explanation
definitions.not_applicable: Retired or a different output abstraction
definitions.unknown: Specific reviewed docs do not establish the capability; not assumed unsupported

requires_key.comment: Bearer DeepSeek API key required for both raw JSON tools.

snippet.comment: Each Search result has a short query-related snippet string.

domains.comment: site: and -site: query operators, including OR alternatives; query syntax rather than typed domain arrays.

country.comment: localization accepts an IP address; region localization is indirect, not an ISO country selector.

language.comment: lang: query operator accepts comma-separated language codes; no typed language field.

date.comment: after: and before: query operators restrict publication dates; no typed date fields.

safe_search.comment: Reviewed request table and operator list document no explicit safe-search setting. Filtering policy or unsupported status is not established.

answer.comment: The documented Search response is results only; per-result summaries are not a top-level synthesized answer. Chat model generation is separate.

content.comment: need_content=true returns page content when available; separate Fetch returns Markdown. No success/content guarantee for every page.

summary.comment: Per-result summary is documented as a longer query-related summary; whether it is AI-generated is not specified.

highlights.comment: Query-related snippet/summary excerpts are returned; no separate highlighted-span array in the complete response schema.

news.comment: The complete Search request contract has no news vertical selector; general search can retrieve news, which is not a dedicated News API.

mode.comment: One raw Search endpoint; count and need_content configure results, not named fast/deep tiers.

requires_key.comment: HTTP Basic authentication with API login/password; credentials are required, although not a bearer API key.

snippet.comment: Organic items expose description as the search-result description.

domains.comment: keyword accepts site: operators; provider documents a 5x task charge for advanced operators. This is query syntax, not include/exclude domain arrays.

country.comment: location_code or location_name select search geography; country locations are documented.

language.comment: language_code or language_name select search engine language; lr is explicitly stripped.

date.comment: search_param forwards supported Google tbs time filters; this is engine date filtering, not guaranteed publication metadata. as_qdr is explicitly stripped.

safe_search.comment: Supported search_param safe=active filters explicit results; engine-specific parameter behavior, not a unified safe_search enum.

answer.comment: Advanced response can contain search-engine ai_overview/answer_box; not an always-generated DataForSEO answer. Async overview retrieval is separately charged.

content.comment: This SERP contract returns result elements and descriptions; the HTML variant returns search-engine SERP HTML, not full text from linked result pages.

summary.comment: Organic result description is an engine snippet; the complete organic item schema has no generated per-result page-summary output. Separate AI Summary products are outside this column.

highlights.comment: highlighted contains bold terms within engine results, not an independently generated excerpt/highlights service.

news.comment: Dedicated Google News SERP endpoint documented. Separate news request/engine variant, no anysearch adapter.

mode.comment: Delivery/priority options, not a unified SDK search quality mode. Queued and live rates differ.

requires_key.comment: REST request API requires bearer API key; proxy interface uses zone credentials.

snippet.comment: Parsed organic results expose description (search snippet).

domains.comment: Indirect engine query operator: provider forwards q in a Google search URL, and Google documents site:. This documented composition is not a typed domain allow/deny guarantee.

country.comment: gl selects two-letter search country; localization is documented.

language.comment: hl sets page/interface language; engine-supported language semantics, not a guarantee every result has that language.

date.comment: tbs filters publication time by engine-supported ranges; engine-specific date syntax rather than typed start/end fields.

safe_search.comment: safe=active or safe=off enables/disables Google SafeSearch.

answer.comment: Parsed Google ai_overview is available when the upstream SERP includes it; no guaranteed independent synthesized answer.

content.comment: Parsed JSON/HTML/Markdown formats describe the SERP response, not fetched full text of linked result pages. Separate scraper products are outside this column.

summary.comment: The documented organic response has description snippets, not generated per-result page summaries. Upstream AI Overview is a separate SERP element.

highlights.comment: snippet_highlighted_words exposes engine-highlighted terms, not a standalone excerpt generation service.

news.comment: tbm=nws selects Google News results; dedicated Fast SERP News also documented.

mode.comment: Fast SERP has separate access requirements; no anysearch fast/balanced/deep mapping.

requires_key.comment: Authenticated Responses API calls use an OpenAI API key.

snippet.comment: Model-mediated cited answers and source metadata are returned, not a contracted raw ranked-result snippet field.

domains.comment: Responses web_search filters allow up to 100 allowed_domains or blocked_domains; legacy Chat Completions search does not have this control.

country.comment: user_location.country accepts a two-letter ISO country code; approximate user location biases search.

language.comment: Reviewed web_search control guide documents no dedicated result-language filter. Prompt language is not equivalent to enforced retrieval language.

date.comment: No typed publication-date range control is documented in the reviewed web_search guide; prompt instructions do not prove enforced filtering.

safe_search.comment: No developer-configurable SafeSearch switch is documented in the reviewed tool guide; model safety behavior is not a search filter.

answer.comment: The model produces a sourced answer with URL citations after web_search.

content.comment: Reasoning tools can open pages and find content for the model; this is not a guaranteed raw full-page export API.

summary.comment: The contracted output is a cited model response, not a per-result summary array. An answer summary must not be confused with page summaries.

highlights.comment: Citation offsets identify spans in generated answer text, not query-relevant source-page highlight excerpts.

news.comment: Official examples search current news via general web_search; no dedicated news-only vertical selector is documented.

mode.comment: Official guide describes three search patterns by model; model-mediated generation, not raw SDK modes.

requires_key.comment: Claude API authentication is required; web_search is a server tool in an authenticated Messages request.

domains.comment: allowed_domains or blocked_domains restrict searches; mutually exclusive in one tool configuration.

country.comment: user_location.country is ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; approximate localization supported.

language.comment: No result-language filter is documented in the reviewed web_search parameter guide. Multilingual model output is not retrieval-language enforcement.

date.comment: page_age is response metadata; the reviewed request controls do not establish an enforced publication-date-range filter.

safe_search.comment: No configurable SafeSearch switch is documented in the reviewed server-tool guide. Safety policy and retrieval filter are distinct.

answer.comment: Claude returns a final answer with citations after tool searches.

news.comment: Official documentation lists recent news as a web-search use case; no news-only vertical control is documented.

mode.comment: Tool versions 20250305, 20260209 and 20260318 provide basic search, dynamic filtering and response-inclusion controls; model availability varies.

country.comment: The web_search parameter table lists domain and image controls but no country bias. Do not transfer X Search settings to Web Search.

language.comment: No result-language filter is documented in the web_search tool parameter table; model language capability is separate.

date.comment: No publication-date range control documented for web_search. X Search from_date/to_date options are a different tool.

safe_search.comment: No configurable SafeSearch setting documented for this tool; model safety is not an equivalent parameter.

No named fast/balanced/deep search tiers; the single Search endpoint is configured by result count, domain_type and date filters.

requires_key.comment: All Search requests require the X-API-Key header.

snippet.comment: Every result exposes a snippet string alongside title, url and site_name.

domains.comment: include_domains and exclude_domains accept comma-separated domain lists; site: operators are deprecated in favour of these parameters.

country.comment: location takes a two-letter country code such as US or GB, defaults to US when omitted, and is resolved from language when only that is set.

language.comment: language takes a language code such as en or fr, defaults to en when omitted, and is resolved from location when only that is set.

date.comment: after_date and before_date accept YYYY-MM-DD and recency_minutes sets a freshness window; research-paper results use pub_year_min and pub_year_max instead.

safe_search.comment: No safe-search or adult-content parameter appears in the Search API reference; a 403 only reports an upstream policy rejection.

answer.comment: The Search response contains ranked links and snippets only; synthesized answers are not part of this scoped contract, and Agent and Research are separate products.

content.comment: Search returns snippets rather than page bodies; page content comes from the separate Fetch API at api.fetch.tinyfish.ai.

summary.comment: The documented Search response has no per-result or query-level summary field.

highlights.comment: Results expose plain snippet text with no highlight offsets or marked terms.

news.comment: domain_type=news returns news articles with publisher and date fields.
